recipe.variant: latent hires fix as a FRAGMENT: LatentUpscale 1.5x (nearest-exact) -> second KSampler at denoise 0.5 (dpmpp_2m / simple / 14 steps / cfg 8) -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage, spliced after any sampler; the official SD1.5 first pass is kept so the file runs and validates on its own
recipe.from_template: hiresfix_latent_workflow (archived; ComfyUI_examples '2 pass txt2img'): EmptyLatentImage 512x512 -> KSampler 12 steps dpmpp_sde/normal cfg 8 denoise 1 -> LatentUpscale nearest-exact 768x768 -> KSampler 14 steps dpmpp_2m/simple cfg 8 denoise 0.5 -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage; the pass-1 VAEDecode + PreviewImage is dropped. Values are the Comfy-Org template JSON's (512 -> 768 with DreamShaper 8; the ComfyUI_examples page shows 768 -> 1152 with v2-1).

upscale_width.note: pass-2 width in pixels, multiple of 8 (template 768 = 1.5x of 512)

upscale_height.note: pass-2 height in pixels, multiple of 8

upscale_method.note: nearest-exact (template) | bilinear | area | bicubic | bislerp (latent-only option)

denoise.note: 0.5 in both official hires-fix examples (0.52 in the pose example, 0.35 in the different-prompt example); lower leaves interpolation blur, higher drifts structure

prompt.note: standalone context only; in a splice the upstream conditioning is used

recipe.inputs_note: no media slot: the fragment consumes the upstream LATENT (see fragment.attach); run standalone it is a txt2img + hires fix
recipe.defaults_note: 1.5x latent upscale (512 -> 768) at denoise 0.5, 14 steps dpmpp_2m/simple, cfg 8, same prompts as pass 1. Latent interpolation is blurry: denoise around 0.5 repairs it (official examples); the pixel path (hires-fix-pixel) tolerates lower denoise.
